role: Independent high-tier auditor. Sees only the specs and the artifacts. Re-runs every acceptance check itself. Never fixes anything. A FAIL goes back to the planner.

replan_needed: task ids that must go back to the planner, with one-line reason each

T02: run the self-test and the round-trip script yourself under a throwaway LOCALAPPDATA; confirm the written settings.json key for Anthropic is not plain text.
